import sqlite3
import stripe
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('legal-billing')
DB_PATH = 'firm.db'

@mcp.tool()
def charge_retainer_to_matter(matter_id: str, amount_cents: int, customer_id: str) -> dict:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount_cents, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, metadata={'matter_id': matter_id})
    with sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH) as conn:
        conn.execute("INSERT INTO trust_ledger (matter_id, amount_cents, payment_ref, kind) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'retainer')", (matter_id, amount_cents, intent.id))
        # Once the retainer is paid, give the client's portal account access to the matter
        if intent.status == 'succeeded':
            conn.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO matter_access (matter_id, customer_id, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'client_viewer')", (matter_id, customer_id))
    return {'payment_id': intent.id, 'status': intent.status}
